title: Biome Variety
description: Variety of biomes with a Vanilla aesthetic.
body: Biome Variety is a mod that adds a handful of biomes to your Minecraft world. Each biome strieves to be unique unlike other biomes, focussing heavily on beauty blended with a vanilla-like aesthetic. The current biomes are. * Baobab plains. An arid sandy plains like biome litter with hollow baobab trees. * Antarctic. Dry with glacial ice floors and small patches of forestry areas, as if the Antarctic past is peaking through. * Redwood Forest. A overgrown and neutral biome with tall Redwood trees that have roots borrowing into the weathered dirt. * Sweets. A sugary biome made out of cake with large cake structures scattered around. This mod requires Terrablender and the Fabric Api. With optional support for Cobblemon. [Click here for a Cobblemon spawn spreadsheet.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kOdc46l7Wi6U5S2sz7fME3K0nwtKPQgpJDEMjFMIEcw/edit?usp=sharing) This mod is currently in beta and will undergo severe changes, it is not reccomended to use for permanent worlds. This mod is open to feedback. [Click here for a form.](https://forms.gle/D7M1gDAPG3eiCGdL8)
